newsitem.title: UK: UK Drew Scientific to launch new test system.
newsitem.headline: UK Drew Scientific to launch new test system.

text.p: British medical diagnostic equipment company Drew Scientific Group Plc said on Wednesday it would launch a new blood testing system in the U.S. and Europe by December, 1997.
The new system will cover the connection between raised homocysteine (HCY) levels and cornonary disease, the company said.

"The positive nature of the findings have resulted in the company revising its development plans for the HCY product, which is now expected to be launched in the U.S. and European markets before the end of 1997," it said
Drew also said it had recently received certification for both its HbGold and Ghb100 glycated haemoglobin analysers.
The certification came followed evaluation by the Diabetes Control and Complications Trial (DCCT) secondary reference laboratory at Zwolle, in the Netherlands.
"As a result of this work, both instruments can now be offered to the market calibrated to provide DCCT-referenced results," Drew Scientific said.
The company's share price was indicated at 155 pence, up 5p from Tuesday's close.
